sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: vehicle title, registration, plates, inspection and insurance
Knowledge facts: part C holds 22 fact blocks (sec14-F01 onward) from physical pages 160 to 163; part C2 holds 13 confusable and continuation blocks (sec14-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the 2026 manual, the 50-question count and the 80 percent (40 of 50) passing standard from physical pages 32 and 33; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NJ-VEH-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NJ-VEH-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NJ-VEH-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: inspection rules, plate fines, plate return addresses and phone lines (for example sec14-F11, sec14-F15) can change and must be refreshed from official New Jersey websites.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
